attack: Guess the 6-digit sign-in code (5 wrong tries, then the right one)
expected: Code locked after 5 wrong tries; even the right code then fails
actual: wrong tries: [400, 400, 400, 400, 400]; right code afterwards: 400

attack: Flood a mailbox by requesting codes repeatedly
expected: Second request within 60 s refused (429)
actual: 202 then 429

attack: Sign in with look-alike domains, a Cyrillic і, an unknown Gmail, or email-header injection (newline + Bcc)
expected: All refused (400/422); no email sent

attack: Use a made-up or tampered session cookie
expected: 401 Not signed in
actual: made-up: 401; one character changed: 401

attack: Inspect the session cookie; reuse it after sign-out
expected: HttpOnly + SameSite; token useless after logout (Secure flag comes from COOKIE_SECURE=true on the server)
actual: flags: HttpOnly, SameSite=lax, Path=/; reuse after logout: 401

attack: Student calls security-staff endpoints directly
expected: 403 for every call
actual: list staff desk: 403, receive item: 403, start review: 403, approve claim: 403, dispose item: 403

attack: Student calls admin endpoints to promote themselves
actual: make self admin: 403, list staff: 403

attack: Mass assignment: send role=ADMIN, a new email, name and roll in a profile update
expected: Role, email, name and roll number unchanged
actual: role=STUDENT, email=attacker.adv@iitk.ac.in, name=Attacker Adv, roll=240002

attack: IDOR: change ids in the URL to read or change another student's items, claims, proofs and ID-card photos
expected: 403/404 for all 9 attempts, victim's data unchanged
actual: read hidden found report: 404, read victim's claim: 404, download victim's proof image: 404, download ID-card photo: 404, edit victim's lost report: 403, close victim's lost report: 403, delete victim's found report: 404, withdraw victim's claim: 404, add photo to victim's report: 403

attack: Mass assignment on a new report (status, kind, reporter_id, id, ai_description)
expected: Extra fields ignored
actual: status=OPEN, kind=LOST, id=5

attack: Claim an item you found yourself; claim the same item twice
expected: Own find refused; second open claim refused
actual: own find: 400; first claim: 201; second: 409

attack: SQL injection in the search box (OR 1=1, DROP TABLE, UNION, pg_sleep)
expected: 200 with no extra rows, no delay, tables intact
actual: "' OR 1=1 --": 200, 0 rows, 0.01 s; "x'); DROP TABLE items; --": 200, 0 rows, 0.01 s; "headphones' UNION SELECT email FROM users --": 200, 0 rows, 0.01 s; "\\'; SELECT pg_sleep(5); --": 200, 0 rows, 0.01 s; "%' OR '%'='": 200, 0 rows, 0.01 s; lost items before/after: 2/2

attack: Injection and abuse through other parameters (kind, category, id, page size)
expected: 422 validation errors or 0 results
actual: kind=FOUND' OR '1'='1: 422, category=x' OR 1=1--: 0, item id 1 OR 1=1: 422, page_size=1000000: 422, page=-1: 422

attack: Stored XSS: script and onerror payloads in an item title and description, viewed by another student
expected: Stored as plain text; nothing runs in the browser
actual: stored as text: True; browser: NO_SCRIPT_RAN; payload shown as text: True

attack: Upload a web shell, SVG with script, renamed .exe, HTML, empty and oversized files
expected: All rejected with 400
actual: PHP web shell named .jpg: 400, SVG with script: 400, Windows .exe renamed: 400, HTML page: 400, empty file: 400, 6 MB file (limit 5 MB): 400

attack: Polyglot file (JPEG header + script/PHP) named ../../app/main.py
expected: May be stored as an image, but under a random name and served as image/jpeg with nosniff, so it can't run
actual: upload: 201; served as: image/jpeg; nosniff: nosniff
note: Server never uses the uploaded file name; content-type comes from the magic bytes.

attack: Upload a phone photo with GPS location in its EXIF data; download it as another student
expected: Location data removed before the photo is shared
actual: GPS still in the downloaded photo: False
note: Finders' photos are shown to every student once the item is at an office.

attack: Decompression bomb: a 136 KB PNG that is 12,000 × 12,000 pixels
expected: Refused by a pixel limit, or processed in bounded memory
actual: upload: 400; memory it would need to decode if accepted: 781 MB
note: The AI photo step (AI_PHOTO_DESCRIPTIONS, on in production) decodes the full image; a few such uploads can exhaust a 2 GB server.

attack: Check the website's security headers (clickjacking, sniffing, CSP)
expected: CSP or X-Frame-Options, nosniff and Referrer-Policy set; no X-Powered-By
actual: missing: none; X-Powered-By: None
note: HSTS is added by Caddy only if configured; the deploy Caddyfile doesn't set it.

attack: Cross-origin request from another website (CORS)
expected: Other origins not allowed
actual: Access-Control-Allow-Origin for evil.example: None

attack: Look for public API documentation
expected: Docs disabled in production
actual: /docs: 404, /openapi.json: 404, /redoc: 404
note: Reachable on the live site at /api/docs and /api/openapi.json; lists every endpoint.

attack: Send malformed input to provoke error pages
expected: Short error messages, no stack traces or internals
actual: broken JSON: 422, unknown route: 404, wrong type: 422; internals leaked: False

attack: Online brute force against a real account with 30 rapid code guesses (no code requested)
expected: Every guess refused; no sign-in
actual: 30 guesses in 0.4 s; statuses: [400]
note: There is no per-IP rate limit; each code allows only 5 tries and expires in 10 minutes, so guessing stays impractical.
